rows.grounds: ratha-ārūḍha plus ca; those mounted on chariots, and

items.question: Which divine protectors mounted on chariots guard the devotee everywhere and always in battle?
items.inference: The verse asks chariot-mounted divine protectors to guard the devotee in every place and time, especially in battle.
uncertainties: The exact divine identity of the chariot-mounted protectors is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: May those mounted on chariots protect me everywhere and always in battle.
